summary: Rotary Club of Deonar launched Rodeo Reach, its club publication for September, highlighting the club's activities, community service initiatives and achievements.
description: Rotary Club of Deonar launched Rodeo Reach, its club publication for September, highlighting the club's activities, community service initiatives and achievements. The publication was presented to members by Club President Rtn. Nalini Kannan, encouraging greater awareness and engagement with the club's work.
